question: Which insurance company won the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) Award for Best Financial Reporting in the Life Insurance category for 2023-24?
solution:
The correct answer is __**HDFC Life.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **HDFC Life won the Silver Shield for Best Financial Reporting at the ICAI Awards for Excellence in Financial Reporting 2023-24.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **HDFC Life received the Silver Shield in Category-III for Life Insurance at the ICAI Awards for Excellence in Financial Reporting 2023-24.**
 
• The award recognizes HDFC Life for its transparency and adherence to financial reporting standards and Indian Accounting Standards.
 
• HDFC Life is the only life insurance company to be awarded this year, with a 99.5% claim settlement ratio for FY24.
 
• The award was presented by Union Minister Shri Arjun Ram Meghwal at the ICAI ceremony held in New Delhi.
